data.name: 1,2,3-Trichlorobenzene with Water
measurement_methods: A small excess of solute in water was agitated for a period of 4-48 hours (the exact time for equilibration was not reported in single cases) and then filtered. The saturated solution was extracted with a small volume of methylene chloride which was then assayed spectrophotometrically. At least two independent determinations were carried out.
mixing_methods: A small excess of solute in water was agitated for a period of 4-48 hours (the exact time for equilibration was not reported in single cases) and then filtered.

publication_references.citation: Yalkowsky, S.H.; Orr, R.J.; Valvani, S.C., Ind. Eng. Chem. Fundam. 1979, 18(4), 351-3.
